title: 第13章 葬剑山第14章 初炼妖丹一掌打爆
content_zh:
第一次进阶，有一点反应也很正常。
按捺下心头的思绪，林玄马不停蹄继续修炼。
这一次，他只炼化了23颗丹药，便突破到了玄气境七层！
“竟然比预估中少了九颗！”
进阶玄气境六层，用了16颗玄气丹。
正常来讲，进阶玄气境七层应该消耗32颗，但他只消耗了23颗，比预计中少用了九颗。
但他的玄气仍然翻了一倍，力量也达到了四十八象，一切都正常。
“明白了！”
看着手中的丹药，他明白了原因所在。
之前的三次突破，用的都是四道金纹的黄阶四品玄气丹。
而这一次，他用了3颗黄阶四品，外加20颗黄阶五品，一共23颗。
显然是五品丹药的药力，让他节省了丹药的数量。
这便是高阶丹药的价值所在，数量虽少，药效更高！
“继续！”
林玄手中只剩下了六颗丹药。
全部都是六道金色丹纹的黄阶六品玄气丹，一口气炼化完毕。
不出所料，他的玄气虽然有所提升，但远未达到进阶的程度。
按他的估算，还需要再炼化40颗左右的同级别丹药才能突破到玄气境八层。
林玄内观自照，仔细检视着修为境界。
玄气境一层时，他的气海仿佛一座小小的水潭，此时却扩张数十倍，如同一座湖泊！

灵桥栈道原本像是一道纤细的独木桥，如今壮大了十倍以上，成为了一道阔步廊桥。
如此变化，让他的修炼速度和效率剧增，丹田的运转也明显加快。
带来的好处，便是玄气驱使由心，力量随叫随到！
而这些变化，还是在没有修炼《鸿蒙霸体诀》的情况下达成。
一旦正式修炼那部法诀，情况还会有巨大的变化。
想起那恐怖的法诀，林玄便眼角收缩，心跳加速。
但他却有种感觉，现在仍然不是修炼它的时候！
现在丹药已经用完，接下来怎么办？
林玄收回思绪，展望后续的行程。
再去白雾城捞金吗？
不！
content_en:
It's normal to have a little reaction when you advance for the first time.
Suppressing his thoughts, Lin Xuan continued practicing without stopping.
This time, he only refined 23 pills and broke through to the seventh level of the Xuanqi realm!
"It turned out to be nine fewer than expected!"
To advance to the sixth level of the Xuanqi realm, 16 Xuanqi pills were used.
Normally, 32 pills should be consumed to advance to the seventh level of the Xuanqi Realm, but he only consumed 23 pills, nine less than expected.
But his profound energy still doubled, his strength reached forty-eight images, and everything was normal.
"Got it!"
Looking at the elixir in his hand, he understood the reason.
The previous three breakthroughs all used the yellow-level fourth-grade Xuanqi Pill with four golden patterns.
But this time, he used 3 yellow-level fourth-grade ones, plus 20 yellow-level fifth-grade ones, for a total of 23.
It was obviously the potency of the fifth-grade elixir that allowed him to save the quantity of elixirs.
This is the value of high-level elixirs. Although the quantity is small, the efficacy is higher!
"Go on!"
Lin Xuan only had six pills left in his hand.
All of them are yellow-grade sixth-grade profound energy pills with six golden pill patterns, and they were refined in one go.
As expected, although his profound energy has improved, it is far from advanced.
According to his estimate, it would take about 40 more pills of the same level to be refined to break through to the eighth level of the Xuanqi realm.
Lin Xuan looked at himself internally and carefully examined his cultivation state.
When he was at the first level of the Xuanqi realm, his Qi sea was like a small pool, but now it expanded dozens of times, like a lake!
The Lingqiao Plank Road originally looked like a slender single-plank bridge, but now it has grown more than ten times and has become a wide-step covered bridge.
Such a change greatly increased his cultivation speed and efficiency, and the operation of his Dantian also accelerated significantly.
The benefit is that the profound energy is driven by the heart, and the power is at your fingertips!
And these changes were achieved without practicing the "Hongmeng Hegemony Technique".
Once you formally practice that method, the situation will change dramatically.
Thinking of that terrifying magic formula, Lin Xuan's eyes contracted and his heartbeat accelerated.
But he had a feeling that now was still not the time to practice it!
Now that the elixir has been used up, what next?
Lin Xuan retracted his thoughts and looked forward to the subsequent trip.
Are you going to Baiwu City again to make money?
No!
